title: Aether selection + demand gate for P1-P4 (read-only, before any adapter)
objective: Decide which of P1 (spatial influence), P2 (causal ancestry), P3 (information transmission), P4 (transformation) Aether supports as a bounded, independently discriminating native experiment -- or reject.
problem: Read Aether/V2B/REACH01/R1_TEST4_RESULT.md, Aether/V2B/TEST-3/OPERATOR_REVIEW.md, Aether/V2B/THREE_FLIGHT_SYNTHESIS_2026-10-07.md, roles/Hestia/audit/2026-10-06/dossiers/Aether.md and the committed Aether source/instrumentation (decode, clamp, non-ancestor, ruler fixtures: 'exchange decodes at r=1 only; relay chain decodes at r=1..6; label-unrelated divergence at chance'). PRESERVE TEST-4's disposition (RECOIL_EXCHANGE_CAUSAL_REACH_NOT_SUPPORTED; information largely gone beyond radius 3): Generation 4 does not reclassify it. For each of P1-P4 state whether the committed source supports: a known-answer positive (a planted relay / chain may qualify the INSTRUMENT, not discovery); a suitable negative control; a native intervention that changes a causal pathway (clamp); an independently recomputable outcome; a bounded resource requirement on harry1 CPU (measure throughput; do not use M2); an observable distinction NOT already settled by TEST-4. The key contrast the directive wants: can the Observatory tell P2 (ancestry) from P3 (recoverable content) -- e.g. a planted chain that propagates structure WITHOUT content vs one that carries content. If P3/P4 are unsupported natively, narrow to P1/P2 and say so; if even P1/P2 lack an independently discriminating question, recommend another spatial system. Do not alter physics. Small re-runs with NEW seeds (declare a range disjoint from every Aether range), committed with commands. Apply the falsifiability checklist (each control: alternative it represents, pass/fail observations, impossibility by construction, privileged access, discrimination) -- rso/qualify/ if landed, else directive s2B text.
non_goals: No edit to Aether/ or roles/Aether/
No Aether registered seed or frozen result
No edit in another seat's lane
evidence_required: SELECTION.md: per-P decision with evidence, controls, unit, interventions, resources, what TEST-4 already settles

acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; committed with source references
